description: Implementation of a synchronous parallel pipeline for concurrent frame processing, including classes for control frames, source and sink processors, and the main pipeline class that manages multiple parallel pipelines with synchronization mechanisms.

classes.name: SyncFrame
classes.description: Control frame used to synchronize parallel pipeline processing, sent through pipelines to determine when internal pipelines have finished processing a batch of frames.

classes.name: SyncParallelPipelineSource
classes.description: Source processor for synchronous parallel pipeline processing, routes frames to upstream queue or downstream processing.

classes.name: SyncParallelPipelineSink
classes.description: Sink processor for synchronous parallel pipeline processing, collects downstream frames and routes upstream frames back.

classes.name: SyncParallelPipeline
classes.description: Main pipeline class that manages multiple parallel pipelines, synchronizing their output to maintain order and prevent duplicate processing using control frames and queues.

methods.name: SyncFrame
methods.description: Data class representing a control frame for synchronization.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the source or sink processor with the provided asyncio queue.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame, routing it based on direction, and handles synchronization logic in the main pipeline.

methods.name: processors
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-processors (pipelines) contained within the parallel pipeline.

methods.name: entry_processors
methods.description: Returns the list of entry processors (sources) for the parallel pipeline.

methods.name: processors_with_metrics
methods.description: Collects processors capable of generating metrics from all parallel pipelines.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the parallel pipeline and all contained processors.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the parallel pipeline and all contained processors.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Main method to process frames through all parallel pipelines with synchronization, coordinating via control frames and queues.
